strings.settings.a_to_m_reset_seed_and_initial: Set this near your usual shot time before resetting Auto learning. The reset uses it to rebuild the recent-shot trend.
strings.settings.after_a_start_or_stop_how_long: How long to wait after a tap for the machine sensor to confirm that water started or stopped. If it has not changed by then, the displayed state follows the sensor.
strings.settings.after_the_decision_time_under_t: When on, a shot that is still under target at the decision time can stop at a lower recovery weight instead of running to the overall limit. Turn off to keep waiting for the target or Max BBW time.
strings.settings.after_you_start_if_the_scale_st: If the scale shows no coffee for this long after Start, the next tap is treated as a new start instead of a stop. Flow that begins later corrects the machine state.
strings.settings.always_finishes_by_weight_or_ti: For an automatic Brew by weight shot, ON uses Natural-style automation. OFF after the rinse window demotes the current shot to Original-style hands-off automation; moving ON promotes it back to Natural-style. Neither transition stops early. With Quick rinse on, early ON→OFF demotes the tentative shot to a rinse. Without weight control, OFF stops normally.
strings.settings.assume_idle_when_the_scale_conn: Assume idle when the scale connects
strings.settings.auto_learns_from_your_last_few_: Uses the last five successful shot durations to set the scale-loss stop deadline, counted from the original shot start.
strings.settings.avoid_accidental_touch_hint: When on, brief bumps or a hand on the scale are ignored so they do not stop or extend the shot. Turn off only if valid weight changes are being ignored.
strings.settings.baseline_learning_factor_hint: Sets how quickly adaptive learning starts responding again after a full reset. Higher values adapt faster; lower values smooth normal shot-to-shot variation.
strings.settings.baseline_offset_hint: The drip compensation restored by Reset learned stop offset. A larger value makes Shot Stopper request the stop earlier after you reset it.
strings.settings.beeps_when_a_scale_connects_or_: When on, a rising sound from the built-in buzzer confirms that a scale connected or reconnected.
strings.settings.beeps_when_brew_by_weight_is_on: When on, the built-in buzzer warns that Brew by weight cannot start normally because the scale is missing, including the first blocked attempt.
strings.settings.beeps_when_the_a_to_m_guard: When on, the built-in buzzer confirms that the A→M guard stopped a shot after the scale was lost.
strings.settings.beeps_when_the_scale_disconnect: When on, the built-in buzzer warns whenever the scale disconnects, so you know weight control may be unavailable.
strings.settings.beeps_while_fast_extraction_gua: Choose how quickly the built-in buzzer pulses while Fast extraction guard keeps a too-fast shot running past its target. Disabled keeps this extension silent.
strings.settings.beeps_while_slow_extraction_gua: Choose how quickly the built-in buzzer pulses while Slow extraction guard keeps a very slow shot running toward its recovery weight. Disabled keeps this extension silent.
strings.settings.blocks_once_then_allows_brewing: Blocks and alerts on the first attempt. Release, then start again to brew manually for the time set below.
strings.settings.brew_without_a_scale: Starts without a scale as a manual shot; you remain responsible for stopping it.
strings.settings.button_press_hint: Tare, timer, and shot state start or stop when the button is pressed. With Quick rinse on, holding from idle to the rinse threshold demotes the tentative shot to a rinse; otherwise exceeding Single-press limit cancels the tentative start or stop while the physical hold remains manual.
strings.settings.button_release_hint: The physical hold still reaches the machine, but tare, timer, and shot state start or stop only after a short release. With Quick rinse on, holding from idle to the rinse threshold starts a rinse directly, never a shot; a longer non-rinse hold causes no start or stop.
strings.settings.buzzer_only_hint: Plays all available alerts on the built-in buzzer. The scale speaker can be silenced separately.
strings.settings.combine_tare_timer_at_shot_star: Sends tare and timer start together for a more synchronized start on Bookoo scales.
strings.settings.cutoff_algorithm_adaptive_hint: Predicts the cutoff from the live weight trend, then learns final-weight error gradually. It smooths shot variation and may adjust its learning speed after enough successful shots; it never changes to the other algorithm automatically.
strings.settings.cutoff_algorithm_offset_hint: Predicts the cutoff from the live weight trend, then applies the full final-weight error from the latest successful shot to the next one. It reacts quickly but follows shot-to-shot variation more closely.
strings.settings.delay_weight_stopping: Prevents an automatic weight stop during the first part of the shot, giving tare, cup placement, and the first drops time to settle.
strings.settings.earliest_normal_target_stop_ear: If the target is reached before this time, Fast guard keeps brewing until this time or Max recovery weight, whichever comes first.
strings.settings.eclair_uses_the_normal_tare_and: Eclair uses the regular tare and timer workflow. It has no extra volume or sound options; alerts it cannot play use the built-in buzzer when available.
strings.settings.enable_cup_protections_also_in_: When on, the selected protections can block a start without a cup or stop a shot when the cup is lifted. Turn off to leave cup handling to the barista.
strings.settings.extend_shots_that_reach_target_: When on, a shot that reaches its target too early continues toward the minimum time or maximum recovery weight. Turn off to stop normally at the target.
strings.settings.extra_wait_for_the_scale_timer_: Waits this extra time before stopping the scale's timer after the shot. Increase it if the displayed scale time lags; it does not delay the machine stop.
strings.settings.first_detected_is_shown_until_a: Choose the remembered scale used by Prefer selected or Preferred only. Until one is saved, the first compatible scale to connect successfully becomes preferred.
strings.settings.fixed_stop_time_from_shot_start: In Manual mode, stop the shot at this time from the original start if the scale is still missing.
strings.settings.how_long_the_automatic_button_p: How long Shot Stopper holds the machine button when stopping automatically. Set enough time for the machine to register one normal press.
strings.settings.how_long_the_cup_must_stay_stea: How long the cup must remain steady before it is accepted as placed. A longer time resists bumps but makes automatic tare and cup protection react more slowly.
strings.settings.how_long_to_hold_the_switch_fro: How long to hold the switch from idle before a rinse starts. A shorter press still starts or stops a shot.
strings.settings.how_long_water_runs_through_the: How long water runs after a Quick rinse begins. When this time ends, Shot Stopper turns the group off automatically.
strings.settings.how_long_you_can_leave_the_padd: How long you can leave the paddle ON and still get a rinse when you flip it OFF. Longer than this starts a shot.
strings.settings.how_loud_the_scale_is_when_it: Sets the Bookoo speaker volume when alerts use the scale. Disabled silences the scale but does not change the built-in buzzer (
strings.settings.how_often_those_reminder_beeps_: Time between paddle-off reminder beeps. A shorter interval reminds you more often.
strings.settings.late_cup_window_measured_from_s: How long after the shot starts a newly placed cup can trigger the extra tare. After this window closes, stop and restart with the cup in place.
strings.settings.lets_you_flush_the_group_with_a: Lets you flush the group with a short paddle flip: ON then OFF runs the machine for a limited time, then stops. Off: a short flip is a normal shot.
Lets you flush the group with a long press from idle: hold the switch to run the machine for a limited time, then stop. Off: a long press is left to the machine.
strings.settings.lightest_stable_weight_that_cou: The lightest stable cup that will be detected. Lower this for very light cups; setting it too low can make small loads look like a cup.
strings.settings.lights_the_blue_led_while_a_sca: When on, the blue light stays lit while a scale is connected. Turn off to keep the light dark without affecting the connection.
strings.settings.longest_hold_that_still_counts_: Holds up to this duration count as a normal start or stop tap. Longer holds remain manual, or start Quick rinse when that option is on.
strings.settings.manual_limit_mode_hint: Uses Manual limit as a fixed scale-loss stop deadline, counted from the original shot start.
strings.settings.max_bbw_time_hint: The longest an automatic Brew by weight shot may run before Shot Stopper stops it, even if the target weight has not been reached.
strings.settings.maximum_500_characters_the_tune: Paste up to 500 characters in RTTTL format. The saved tune remains when Bullseye melody is off; use Test it to preview it.
strings.settings.maximum_difference_between_the_: How much the cup readings may vary and still count as steady. Lower values require a steadier scale; higher values accept more movement.
strings.settings.maximum_gap_between_stable_cup_: The longest gap allowed between readings used to detect a stable cup. Increase it only if a slower scale is breaking otherwise steady detections.
strings.settings.name: Name
strings.settings.no_brand_specific_settings: This scale uses the shared scale, tare, timer, and alert settings above; there are no additional options for this brand.
strings.settings.off_keeps_tare_timer_physical_s: When on, Shot Stopper automatically ends the extraction near this preset's target weight. When off, you control the stop; automatic tare, the timer, and the 60-second safety limit still work.
strings.settings.offset_reset_keeps_ewma_reset_r: Reset learned stop offset keeps the current learning speed. Reset EWMA learning restores both saved baseline values and starts learning again.
strings.settings.one_beep_when_the_first_coffee_: When on, one beep marks the first coffee drops during an automatic shot. Turn off for no first-drop cue.
strings.settings.play_a_custom_rtttl_melody_when: When on, plays your custom melody after the final settled drink weight stays exactly at the target. Available only in
strings.settings.prefer_selected_hint: Waits briefly for the saved preferred scale, then accepts another compatible scale. If none has been saved yet, the first successful connection becomes preferred.
strings.settings.preferred_only_hint: Connects only to the saved preferred scale. If none has been saved yet, the first compatible scale to connect successfully becomes preferred.
strings.settings.preset_name_hint: The name shown on Home and Settings. Use a short name that identifies the basket, dose, or drink this recipe is for.
strings.settings.protection_returns_after_hint: How long manual brewing stays available after the first warning or a temporary override. When it ends, the selected no-scale protection returns.
strings.settings.recovery_ceiling_must_exceed_ta: The greatest drink weight allowed when Fast guard extends a shot that reached the target too early. The shot stops here even if the minimum time has not passed; choose a value above Target.
strings.settings.recovery_floor_must_be_below_ta: The minimum drink weight Slow guard tries to reach before stopping a very slow shot. If it is already reached at the decision time, the shot stops then; choose a value below Target.
strings.settings.reminds_you_to_return_the_paddl: When on, repeating beeps remind you to return the paddle after an automatic stop while it is still ON. Turn off to silence this reminder.
strings.settings.reset_this_factory_preset_to_it: Reset this factory preset to its default values?
strings.settings.save_bases_before_resetting: Save changed baseline values before resetting, or the previously saved values will be restored.
strings.settings.scale_only_hint: Sends alerts to the scale. Sounds the scale cannot play stay silent; shot start and stop still use the built-in buzzer.
strings.settings.shorter_stop_limit_after_scale_: When on, a shot that loses its scale stops at a learned or fixed time instead of waiting for the normal maximum. If the scale reconnects first, automatic weight control resumes.
strings.settings.stable_readings_required_for_id: How many steady readings are needed before a cup is treated as placed. More readings resist brief bumps but make automatic tare and cup protection react more slowly.
strings.settings.stop_if_the_tared_cup_is_remove: When on, lifting the tared cup stops an automatic shot. When off, the shot keeps running until another stop condition is reached.
strings.settings.stops_reminding_after_this_time: How long paddle-off reminders may continue. After this time they stop, even if the paddle remains ON.
strings.settings.tare_a_late_cup_once_within_the: When on, placing the cup shortly after the shot starts triggers one extra tare without restarting the timer. Automatic tare at shot start must also be on.
strings.settings.tare_at_shot_start_including_ti: When on, the connected scale is zeroed at the start of every shot, including timer-only shots. Turn off only when you will prepare the scale's zero yourself.
strings.settings.tare_each_stable_cup_placement_: When on, placing a new stable cup while the machine is idle tares it automatically. Adding coffee or a spoon to a cup already on the scale does not tare again.
strings.settings.target_weight_hint: The final drink weight this preset aims for. Shot Stopper learns when to stop the water so the settled weight lands close to this value.
strings.settings.the_original_tater_mazer_shot_s: ON starts. After the rinse window, OFF hands an automatic Brew by weight shot to weight and time control. Moving ON again promotes that shot to Natural, so the next OFF stops it. Until the first OFF, automatic stopping waits but the 60-second safety limit remains. With Quick rinse on, early ON→OFF demotes the tentative shot to a rinse. Without weight control, OFF stops normally.
strings.settings.the_paddle_works_like_a_normal_: ON starts and OFF stops. Leave ON for automatic weight or time stopping, or move OFF to stop early. With Quick rinse on, ON→OFF inside the rinse window demotes the tentative shot to a rinse.
strings.settings.the_shot_will_not_start_until_a: When on, an automatic shot starts only after a cup has been detected on the connected scale. If the cup was already tared before connection, lift it and place it again.
strings.settings.time_before_the_slow_guard_take: The point when Slow guard decides that a shot is too slow. It stops now if Minimum recovery has been reached; otherwise it keeps brewing toward that weight, up to Max BBW time.
strings.settings.turns_all_brew_alert_sounds_on_: When off, all brew alert sounds are silent on both the scale and built-in buzzer; your individual alert choices are kept. The blue connection light is unaffected.
strings.settings.use_the_first_scale_found_prefe: Connects whichever compatible scale appears first and does not lock it as preferred.
strings.settings.wait_for_drips_before_saving_fi: How long to wait after water stops before recording the final drink weight and learning from it. A longer delay includes more drips; zero records immediately.
strings.settings.wait_for_zero_after_tare_before: After each automatic tare, ignore weight for stopping this long while the reading settles. The shot timer and first-drop detection continue.
strings.settings.weight_at_or_below_this_means_t: How far below zero the reading must fall before the cup is treated as lifted. Values closer to zero react sooner; more negative values ignore larger fluctuations.
strings.settings.when_alerts_use_only_the_buzzer: When on, silences the Bookoo speaker on its first connection so alerts come only from the built-in buzzer. Applies when
strings.settings.when_the_scale_connects_and_you: When on, a scale connecting between shots marks the machine as idle without pressing its button. Turn off if the scale often connects while water is already running.
strings.settings.where_alert_sounds_play_scale_p: Uses the scale when it is connected and can play the alert; otherwise uses the built-in buzzer. It never uses both for one event. Shot start and stop always use the built-in buzzer.
strings.settings.won_t_brew_without_a_scale_togg: Blocks every attempt until the scale reconnects. To brew manually for the time set below, move the physical control ON and OFF three times within two seconds, then start again.
strings.settings.you_have_unsaved_preset_changes: You have unsaved preset changes. Discard them and create a new preset?
You have unsaved preset changes. Discard them and duplicate?
strings.shell.this_window_was_deactivated_due_to: This window was deactivated due to inactivity, or because another window was opened in a different browser or device. Press Reload to enable this window again.
